evals.name: phase-skill-created-without-recurring-authoring-fixes
evals.prompt: Create a portable Skill named change-review in the assigned isolated sandbox. It reviews an authorized software change against acceptance criteria, may delegate a read-only review, and delivers a review report. It must work for complete, incomplete and no-change candidates. Keep discovery metadata useful alongside neighboring implementation and test Skills. Include only the references and verification steps this responsibility needs. This task authorizes isolated Skill authoring, its proportionate deterministic automation, static inspection and supported format validation only. Do not launch nested model/provider/agent evaluations, grading, regrading or retries; do not alter live installations or perform publication. Available agent_runner capability is not execution authority. Retained historical CLI references are not instructions to invoke retired commands. Report unsupported or unenforced requested constraints, including budget and isolation limits, rather than dropping them or claiming they are satisfied.
assertions: Description states responsibility and activation without procedural or obligation lists
Operational reference reading deadlines precede the actions they govern
Output-only contracts load after investigation immediately before reporting
Each reference is linked once in the entrypoint with a local action condition
Numbered delivery checks verify phase results before writing the report
Delegated returns are inspected when delegation occurs
Missing evidence remains explicit for blocked delivery
Missing permissions remain explicit for no-change delivery
Already loaded unchanged guidance is reused rather than mechanically reread
References appear inside consuming workflow steps rather than a conditional preload catalog
One ordered progression covers investigation through delivery without a duplicate checklist
Structural simplification preserves permission and blocking safeguards
evals.expected_output: A contained valid English Skill with concise discovery metadata, action-local reference deadlines, ordered delivery checks and actual static validation evidence.
